name: Project OOO Jazz Piano Curriculum v1
design_principles: Sequence skills by dependency, not calendar date.
Use repertoire as the integration layer across harmony, ear, rhythm, voicings and improvisation.
Prefer chord-tone and guide-tone fluency before heavy chord-scale abstraction.
Keep only 2–3 genuinely new concepts active at once; everything else is maintenance, repertoire or play.
Learn language by ear, extract the underlying device, transpose it, vary it, then integrate it into standards.
Mastery is demonstrated by playing, hearing or applying—not by consuming a lesson.

nodes.title: 7th-chord quality fluency
nodes.goal: Recognize and build maj7, min7, dom7, m7b5, dim7 quickly in every key.
practice_recipe: Build each quality from a named root
Randomize roots instead of cycling mechanically
mastery_tests: Build any requested quality in <3 sec in all 12 keys

nodes.title: Shell voicings: root–3–7
nodes.goal: Play functional shell voicings with minimal motion.
mastery_tests: All 12 major ii–V–I without stopping at 60 BPM

nodes.title: Guide-tone lines through changes
nodes.goal: Hear and play smooth 3rd/7th lines through common progressions.
practice_recipe: Connect nearest guide tones through a standard
mastery_tests: Guide tones through Autumn Leaves from memory
Sing top guide tone before playing

nodes.title: Major ii–V–I fluency
nodes.goal: See, hear and play major ii–V–I as one unit in every key.
practice_recipe: Transpose one simple line through all keys
mastery_tests: 12 keys at 72 BPM, one chord per bar
Recognize ii–V–I by ear in 8/10 examples

nodes.title: Minor iiø–V7alt–i fluency
nodes.goal: Internalize the basic minor ii–V–i sound and functions.

nodes.title: Secondary dominants
nodes.goal: Recognize and hear V of ii, iii, IV, V, vi in standards.
mastery_tests: Analyze 8 secondary dominants in tunes correctly

nodes.title: I–vi–ii–V and common turnarounds
nodes.goal: Recognize and play turnaround families without reading.
mastery_tests: Use one in a tune intro/ending

nodes.title: Tritone substitution
nodes.goal: Hear and apply bII7 as substitute for V7.

nodes.title: Diminished passing harmony
nodes.goal: Recognize common passing and dominant-function diminished chords.
practice_recipe: Find passing diminished chords in standards
mastery_tests: Use one passing diminished device in comping

nodes.title: Backdoor dominant / iv–bVII–I
nodes.goal: Recognize and hear common backdoor motion.

nodes.title: Modal harmony basics
nodes.goal: Sustain coherent improvisation over static/modal harmony.

nodes.title: Rootless A voicings
nodes.goal: Play compact left-hand rootless voicings through functional harmony.
mastery_tests: Two full choruses of a standard with no voicing lookup

nodes.title: Rootless B voicings
nodes.goal: Alternate A/B forms for smoother voice leading and register control.
mastery_tests: Comp through 2 tunes using mixed A/B forms

nodes.title: Add 9ths and 13ths by function
nodes.goal: Color basic voicings with idiomatic tensions without losing function.
practice_recipe: Avoid notes that obscure chord quality

nodes.title: Two-hand spread voicings
nodes.goal: Create full ensemble-compatible voicings with clear register separation.
practice_recipe: Apply to ballad and medium swing

nodes.title: Quartal voicings
nodes.goal: Use fourth-based voicings in modal and modern contexts.
mastery_tests: Comp full modal form with varied shapes

nodes.title: Minor ii–V–i voicings
nodes.goal: Voice minor cadences smoothly with b9/alt color.
mastery_tests: Apply through Autumn Leaves minor cadences

nodes.title: Altered dominant voicings
nodes.goal: Control b9/#9/b13/#11 colors by resolution.
practice_recipe: Voice one alteration family at a time
Apply to minor ii–V and tritone subs

nodes.title: Diminished voicing vocabulary
nodes.goal: Use diminished structures as functional passing material.

nodes.title: Melodic top voice in comping
nodes.goal: Make comping sound like connected lines rather than isolated chord blocks.
practice_recipe: Limit top voice to stepwise motion
mastery_tests: Comp one chorus with singable top line

nodes.title: Swing subdivision and placement
nodes.goal: Internalize swing feel beyond mechanical triplet approximation.
practice_recipe: Play one-note lines with metronome on 2&4

nodes.title: Offbeat accents and syncopation
nodes.goal: Phrase across beats instead of accenting every downbeat.
practice_recipe: Copy rhythms from recordings on one pitch
mastery_tests: Create 8-bar phrase with varied accent placement

nodes.title: Basic swing comping cells
nodes.goal: Use a small set of reliable comping rhythms with good time.

nodes.title: Comping variation and density
nodes.goal: Control density and leave space behind a soloist.
mastery_tests: Comp 2 choruses with intentional density arc

nodes.title: 2-, 4-, and 8-bar phrase awareness
nodes.goal: Shape improvised ideas across formal phrase lengths.
mastery_tests: Hear and demonstrate 4-bar boundaries without counting aloud
Record one 32-bar solo with clear phrase architecture

nodes.title: Sparse metronome practice
nodes.goal: Own internal pulse with less external timekeeping.
mastery_tests: Hold form 3 minutes with click every 2 bars
Recover quickly after intentional click mute

nodes.title: Interactive comping
nodes.goal: React to melodic space like an ensemble pianist.
practice_recipe: Comp behind recordings at low volume
mastery_tests: One recorded chorus feels responsive, not continuous
Can explain where you intentionally left space

nodes.title: Basic bossa comping
nodes.goal: Play a stable bossa groove under standards.
practice_recipe: Apply to Blue Bossa / Girl from Ipanema

nodes.title: Ballad time and rubato control
nodes.goal: Phrase and accompany ballads without overfilling space.
mastery_tests: Perform one ballad intro+head with consistent pulse or intentional rubato

nodes.title: Chord-tone soloing
nodes.goal: Outline harmony melodically before relying on scales.
mastery_tests: One full chorus clearly outlines harmony without backing chords
Can target 3rd on every new chord

nodes.title: ii–V–I chord-tone lines
nodes.goal: Create connected lines across ii–V–I rather than treating chords separately.
mastery_tests: Improvise ii–V–I in 12 keys without stopping

nodes.title: Diatonic and chromatic approach notes
nodes.goal: Create forward motion into important chord tones.

nodes.title: Enclosures
nodes.goal: Enclose chord tones with idiomatic chromatic/diatonic motion.
mastery_tests: Use 3 enclosure shapes in all 12 keys

nodes.title: Bebop resolutions to strong beats
nodes.goal: Control chromatic notes by resolving chord tones onto metrically strong points.
mastery_tests: 8 bars of eighth-note line with strong harmonic clarity
Transpose one model line through 6 keys

nodes.title: Motif development
nodes.goal: Develop small ideas instead of constantly inventing new material.
mastery_tests: One chorus built primarily from one motif

nodes.title: Blues language
nodes.goal: Use blues vocabulary with phrasing rather than running a blues scale.

nodes.title: Turnaround language
nodes.goal: Connect I–vi–ii–V with idiomatic bebop motion.

nodes.title: Minor ii–V–i lines
nodes.goal: Navigate minor cadence with clear targets and altered dominant color.

nodes.title: Space and conversational phrasing
nodes.goal: Use silence intentionally.
mastery_tests: Record a chorus with audible space and coherent answers

nodes.title: Sing scale degrees in key
nodes.goal: Hear scale-degree function before touching the keyboard.

nodes.title: Hear 7th-chord qualities
nodes.goal: Differentiate common jazz chord qualities by sound.

nodes.title: Hear ii–V–I and minor ii–V–i
nodes.goal: Recognize functional cadence direction aurally.

nodes.title: Sing 3rds and 7ths through changes
nodes.goal: Audiates harmonic motion through guide tones.
mastery_tests: Sing one guide-tone line through full tune accurately

nodes.title: Copy 2–4 note melodies by ear
nodes.goal: Shorten the hear→sing→play loop.

nodes.title: Hear bass/root movement
nodes.goal: Track roots and common cycle motion in standards.
mastery_tests: Transcribe roots of a 16-bar standard section

nodes.title: Transcribe 1–2 bar jazz phrases
nodes.goal: Copy short language accurately and connect ear to instrument.
mastery_tests: Learn phrase by ear without slowing below 75%

nodes.title: Copy jazz rhythms by ear
nodes.goal: Separate rhythmic hearing from pitch difficulty.

nodes.title: Hear 8-bar sections and form
nodes.goal: Stay oriented in 32-bar forms without constant counting.
mastery_tests: Do not get lost over 3 choruses

nodes.title: Micro-transcription habit
nodes.goal: Build jazz vocabulary from tiny, memorable chunks.
mastery_tests: Can sing phrase cold after 7 days

nodes.title: Extract concept from a phrase
nodes.goal: Turn copied language into transferable devices.
mastery_tests: Use underlying concept in 3 new contexts

nodes.title: Transpose vocabulary
nodes.goal: Move phrases by function rather than finger memory.
mastery_tests: Phrase in 12 keys at moderate tempo

nodes.title: Vary learned vocabulary
nodes.goal: Transform vocabulary into personal material.
mastery_tests: Use at least 2 naturally in a tune

nodes.title: Integrate language into standards
nodes.goal: Make vocabulary appear naturally in real improvisation.
mastery_tests: Phrase or concept appears unforced in 2 recordings

nodes.title: Transcribe an 8–16 bar solo section
nodes.goal: Develop longer-form hearing, articulation and phrasing.

nodes.title: Listening map
nodes.goal: Know the sound and landmarks of a tune before analysis.
mastery_tests: Recognize tune and sing main melody

nodes.title: Learn melody deeply
nodes.goal: Play and sing melody with phrasing, not just decode notes.
mastery_tests: Play melody from memory with form intact

nodes.title: Root map and form
nodes.goal: Memorize harmonic skeleton and formal sections.

nodes.title: Shell harmonization
nodes.goal: Connect tune harmony to functional shell voicings.

nodes.title: Guide-tone / chord-tone solo
nodes.goal: Improvise while clearly tracking the changes.

nodes.title: Full voicing pass

nodes.title: Language application pass
nodes.goal: Apply current improvisation concept in context.
mastery_tests: Concept appears naturally at least twice

nodes.title: Performance pass
nodes.goal: Play a complete musical version without stopping.

nodes.title: Own the tune

mastery_tests: Can count off and play with others
